headline: ✅ THE MONEY LANDED — 195 LAKE VIEW IS FUNDED AND CLOSING #24 IS REAL. At 5:12 this afternoon the milestone engine flipped it CLOSING → CLOSED on two independent receipts: the Real payday notice and the title survey. That ends a four-day watch this board deliberately refused to close early, and it pushes your run rate back above the survive line for the first time in three days. 🏡 THE SECOND-BEST THING TODAY WAS A PRICE ANSWER: 2127 Hwy 93 went to $999K at 7:55 this morning and produced TWO showings inside six hours — both from the same office, one of them already walked at 3:45. In the 40 days before the cut it had two tours total. · DO: call Mike H. — he phoned at 2:44 to say he still has not received your report, and that is the second time he has said it · DECIDE: 355 Comanche expires 9/8 with tour #21 tomorrow — price talk this week or ride it out · WATCH: the seller-import lane is down, Remine's session expired at 4:23 and 20 leads a day stop quietly.

notes: ✅ THE ONE NUMBER THIS BOARD HAS BEEN HOLDING BACK FOR FOUR DAYS FINALLY CLEARED. 195 Lake View Cir closed on paper Friday afternoon and this desk kept counting 23, on the rule that a scheduled closing is not a closed one. At 5:12 PM the engine found the funding receipt — the Real payday notice AND the title survey, two independent sources, not one — and moved it to CLOSED. ⭐ THE YEAR NOW READS 24. Two seller drafts and the post-close follow-up sequence were staged unsent behind it; the celebration call is yours to make.

🔴 THE SELLER-IMPORT LANE WENT DOWN THIS AFTERNOON AND IT IS THE QUIET KIND OF FAILURE. Remine's sign-in session expired, and that lane is where roughly twenty seller leads a day come from — it does not error loudly, it just stops producing. The deep sweep logged it BLOCKED at 4:32 and left a chip; one sign-in restarts it. ⚠️ Two other parts of that same sweep — the activity feed and the geography pass — were idle again today, which is now their fourth consecutive run.

📞 A CLIENT PICKED UP THE PHONE TO TELL YOU YOUR EMAIL NEVER ARRIVED. Mike H. left a five-second voicemail at 2:44 — “Just letting you know I didn't get anything from you” — about the 6161 Eagle Point value report sent Friday. ⭐ THE HONEST PART: no bounce was ever generated, so nothing in the fleet could have known. Branded HTML that leaves clean is not branded HTML that arrives. A plain-text resend is staged and unsent. 📉 Separately your approval queue went from 23 drafts to 8 between 3:15 and 5:35 — you cleared it yourself.

callBlock.why: He called at 2:44 to say he still has not received the value report you sent Friday — the second time he has reported it, and the first time by voice. A plain-text resend is staged, but the call is the part the draft cannot do: the real gap is whether the house is 3,600 or 4,000+ square feet, and that is the whole distance between your number and his.

He texted his buy-box back unprompted — 4 bed, 3.5–4 bath, up to $300K. Oldest open row on the board at ten days, and as of this afternoon it is the first row carrying a finished artifact: the tap-to-call and the full opening text are already written for you.

Back in the listing alerts after five quiet weeks, and the last real contact was a July tour. Panhandle buyer, 1031 money, west-end short-term-rental box — he is not a browser and nobody has spoken to him since.
On your site for twenty-nine straight minutes in the high-$600s and untouched for a year. A full artifact is staged behind this one too — nothing left to write, only to press.

Net-new buyer registration on your own site at 4:09 this afternoon, first-touch email out at 4:40. She is the freshest lead you own and the machine cannot text her — a voice inside the first hours is the whole advantage.
Flagged HOT in your own CRM with a review call that has been overdue since March 27. Five months on a lead the system itself marked as your best kind.
A past client — you sold her house — asking for a valuation on her Fairhope home, overdue since 8/14. Past-client seller asks do not sit for two weeks anywhere else in this business.
Seller hand-raise on a Chelsea Park address that came in Saturday morning; his first-touch went out at 7:12 today and he has not been spoken to. Warm right now, cold by Wednesday.

listings.status: ✅ CLOSED — funded and receipted at 5:12 this afternoon, closing #24 of the year
listings.note: ✅ IT IS DONE, AND IT IS DONE ON RECEIPTS RATHER THAN OPTIMISM. This board held 195 Lake View at CLOSING for four days after the Friday appointment, refusing to count it, because nothing anywhere said the money had actually moved. At 5:12 PM the milestone engine found two independent sources at once — the Real payday notice and the title company's survey — and flipped it CLOSED. ⭐ THE DISCIPLINE PAID: the year is 24 because a receipt arrived, not because a calendar said so. 🎉 WHAT IS STAGED AND UNSENT: two seller notes and the post-close 30- and 90-day follow-up sequence. 📞 The one thing a machine cannot do here is the phone call that says congratulations.

listings.status: 🔥 ACTIVE at $999,000 — the reprice produced two showings in six hours, one already walked
listings.note: 🔥 THE PRICE CUT ANSWERED THE SAME DAY IT WAS MADE. You went $1,150,000 → $999,000 at about 7:55 this morning. By 1:41 PM two agents had booked — and both are from the SAME office, ARC Realty–Hoover. Sarah J. took Friday 9/4 at 8:30 AM; Cathy O. took TODAY 3:45–4:45 PM and blocked a full hour. ⭐ THE COUNTER TELLS THE STORY BETTER THAN ANY OPINION: total showings on this house went from 2 to 4 in one afternoon. In the forty days before the cut it produced two tours, total. 📞 THE FRESHEST READ THAT WILL EVER EXIST on whether $999K works ended at 4:45 today and belongs to Cathy O. — a chip is on your call list. ⚠️ The only written feedback on this house calls it “very dated for the asking price,” but it was written three days BEFORE the reprice and every price field on that form was left blank. It is a condition read against an old number. 🎯 The sellers have not been told about either booking yet — make Cathy's call first, then theirs.

listings.status: ✅ UNDER CONTRACT — appraisal ordered this afternoon, closes 9/21
listings.note: ✅ THE FILE ADVANCED TODAY: the lender's appraisal order came through and the engine moved this INSPECTION → APPRAISAL at 5:12. No value yet — an order is not an opinion, and this board will not report one until a number exists. 🏆 The hard half is already behind you: sixty-three pages read line by line on Saturday and a written game plan to your sellers before 8:40 AM. 🔴 THE PART STILL OPEN IS THE ONE YOU PROMISED TWICE IN WRITING — a call, in three piles: fix, credit, decline. A seller who hears three piles instead of nineteen items says yes on the phone.

listings.status: 🔴 BACK ON THE MARKET — contract ruled dead this morning, one real tour booked Wednesday
listings.note: 🔴 THE OFFER IS DEAD BY YOUR OWN RULING at 7:12 this morning — the buyer could not get approved, which is financing, not neglect, and it ends six days of chasing a PDF nobody could open. 🚨 THE HARDER STORY TODAY WAS THE MACHINE'S: the report auto-sent at 8:30 promised your seller a Tuesday 9/1 tour that does not exist. Eight days of receipts were enumerated one at a time and only WEDNESDAY 9/2 6:00 PM is real. She caught it herself at 11:58 and wrote in. ✅ You closed that card this afternoon. 📄 One quiet win: the flood declarations arrived at 1:41 today, closing the insurance question that has been open since 8/23. ⚠️ Machine email to her remains stopped by rule — voice only.

listings.status: ⏳ ACTIVE — tour #21 tomorrow at 4:30, and the agreement expires 9/8
listings.note: ⏳ EIGHT DAYS TO EXPIRY AND A FRESH SET OF EYES TOMORROW. Chad B. of RE/MAX Advantage booked TUE 9/1 4:30–5:30 PM — his first visit, the twenty-first showing on this house, and he reserved a full hour where most agents here take twenty-five minutes. 🔍 THE STANDING FINDING IS UNCHANGED AND IT IS STRONG: two independent brokerages gave the identical verdict — “stairs were too steep” — and BOTH left every price field blank. Two agents, two offices, one physical objection, zero price objections. ⚠️ A competing FSBO was named for the first time last week by the agent who toured Saturday; she named no replacement number, so the number to quote is still $295,000 and nothing else. 📞 THE BLOCKER CLEARED THIS AFTERNOON — the seller-contact gap that stopped this call being built was retired at 1:55 today. There is now nothing standing between you and the expiry conversation.

listings.status: 📞 THE REPORT IS SENT AND HE SAYS HE HAS NOT SEEN IT — second report, first by voice
listings.note: 📞 HE CALLED AT 2:44 THIS AFTERNOON: “Just letting you know I didn't get anything from you.” Five seconds, and the second time he has said it. The value report went out Friday. ⭐ NO BOUNCE WAS EVER GENERATED — nothing in this fleet could have known, and that is the lesson worth keeping: branded HTML that leaves clean is not branded HTML that arrives. 📧 A plain-text resend is staged and unsent, offering him text, a different address, or hand delivery. 🎯 THE REAL ARGUMENT WAS NEVER PRICE — it is square footage. Your read is mid-to-high $600s on records showing 3,600 sq ft; his is near $800K on a house he says is over 4,000. Settle the measurement and the number settles itself. You promised him re-run comps for 4,000+ homes in Eagle Point — that promise is four days old.

listings.status: ⚠️ ACTIVE — day 161, agreement expiring, and Friday's read is now ~4 days overdue
listings.note: ⚠️ THE DEADLINE IS THE STORY, NOT THE TRAFFIC. The brokerage has flagged this listing agreement as expiring and asked for a seller's-disclosure revision alongside it. 🔴 THE PRICE CONVERSATION YOU TOLD THIS CLIENT YOU OWED HIM ON 8/24 IS STILL OPEN, and an expiring agreement is the cheapest possible moment to have it. ⏳ Friday's midday tour — the eleventh on this unit — has filed nothing in about four days, and the access question that agent asked still has no answer anywhere on record.

listings.status: ⚠️ ACTIVE — 45 tours, no offer, two September mornings booked back to back
listings.note: ⚠️ FORTY-FIVE WALKS WITH NO OFFER IS A PRICE STORY WEARING A TRAFFIC STORY'S CLOTHES. The last two written feedbacks both answered “too high” outright — the only listing you own where agents tick that box rather than leave it blank. 📅 WHAT STILL HOLDS: one brand-new agent reserved Sat 9/12 9:00 AM and Sun 9/13 9:00 AM, two consecutive mornings. ⭐ Friday's cancellation two minutes before the appointment is not a pricing verdict and this board does not report it as one — the buyer fell in love with another house and never entered this one.

✅ THE FILE IS HEALTHY AND ON SCHEDULE. ⚠️ Two quiet items remain and both are paperwork rather than condition: the inspection requests have now been sitting with your seller since 8/20 — eleven days. 🎯 Two weeks out from a closing is the last comfortable moment to clear paperwork; after that it becomes a rush.

listings.status: ✅ UNDER CONTRACT — roof addendum fully signed, closes 10/23
listings.note: 🎉 BOTH SELLERS HAVE SIGNED and this file has now held steady at inspection through twelve consecutive engine runs — the quietest file you own. 🔍 Only the escrow holdback sizing remains loose, and it is not urgent at eight weeks out.

listings.status: 📅 COMING SOON — 22.63 acres, price ruled at $575K, list date still blank
listings.note: ⏳ THE ANSWER THIS LISTING NEEDED ARRIVED TEN DAYS AGO AND NOBODY PICKED IT UP — your coordinator posted the gate code to the shared board on 8/21 and it has sat in Questions for Gene with zero comments since. 📋 STILL OPEN BEHIND IT: the perc documentation and the covenants. ⭐ The price is ruled; everything blocking the launch is paperwork and one unread board card.

listings.status: 🔥 ACTIVE at $599K — highest lead yield you own, and the buy-boxes keep getting clearer
listings.note: 🔍 THE FURTHEST-ALONG BUYER ANSWERED AND IT IS A NO — he wants un-entitled acreage. ⭐ THAT IS A BUY-BOX, NOT A REJECTION, and it is worth more than a maybe: it tells you which builder profile to stop pitching. 📤 The document package went to a builder Thursday and, per your own rule, went without mentioning perc.

listings.status: 📭 COMING SOON — first full weekday gone, calendar still empty
listings.note: 📭 IT WENT LIVE ON A SUNDAY AND THE CALENDAR IS STILL BLANK AT THE END OF MONDAY — no request, no confirmation, no cancellation on a fresh fourteen-day pull. ⏳ One weekday is not a verdict, but it is now a full one. ⭐ Willow Point is the argument for patience on exactly this point: three days of paid ads with no tours, then five bookings and a signed offer in eleven days once the market found it. 🎯 What changes the read is tomorrow — two blank weekdays in a row means marketing, not waiting.

listings.status: 🔥 ACTIVE — price cut live, no tours in the window
listings.note: 🔧 A REAL CATCH THIS MORNING, TWO AND A HALF HOURS BEFORE IT PUBLISHED: this listing's branded card had been rendered carrying an overstated sales claim and was attached to a 7:30 AM post. It was re-rendered, re-hosted and the post re-pointed before it fired. ⚠️ WHAT IS STILL YOURS TO FIX: a post from 8/20 still shows the old price, and only you can delete it — the machine cannot reach that account.

pipeline.paceProjection: ✅ TWENTY-FOUR. The number this board refused to count for four days became real at 5:12 this afternoon when the funding receipt landed on 195 Lake View — two independent sources, the payday notice and the title survey. 📈 WHAT IT MOVES: at day 243, twenty-four closings annualises to about 36.1, back ABOVE the 35-per-year survive line after three straight days below it. Twenty-three annualised to 34.6 — one closing was the difference between surviving and not, on paper. ⏳ STILL SEVEN BEHIND THE 45 GOAL, and that is the honest frame: clearing the survive line is not clearing the goal. 🔴 THE PIPELINE ALSO LOST A FILE TODAY, NOT A DEAL — the Willow Point contract was ruled dead at 7:12 this morning, so that house returns to the active column and out of the forecast. This morning's 5:51 forecast — 4.70 expected closings, about $40,775 of weighted GCI — was derived BEFORE both of today's changes; treat it as one file high and one closing light until the next run re-derives it. ⏳ WHAT IS ACTUALLY BEHIND IT NOW: 198 Rena closing 9/21 with the appraisal ordered today, 3350 Altamont on 9/14, and 1709 Fieldstone on 10/23 outside the window. Anything closing inside 2026 must be under contract by roughly Oct 31 — nine weeks from today. 👥 Team pace reads 37 on the latest verified sheet; note that sheet counts against 80, not the 90 carried here, and the discrepancy has not been reconciled.

money.note: ⏳ THE BANKING DAY IS OVER AND NOTHING NEW LANDED EITHER WAY. The inbox was swept again this evening: no second bank notice, no new returned item, no low-balance mail since this morning's alert. That is the honest read — unchanged, not resolved, and the window to act on it has now closed for today. ⚠️ A RETURNED ITEM ON THE PERSONAL ACCOUNT IS STILL CONFIRMED FOR 8/28, the second inside five days, found by a scan that deliberately widened across the weekend and opened every alert body rather than reading subject lines. 🔴 TOMORROW IS A DRAFT DATE, and the balance that would cover it has not been re-stamped since Friday evening — by this desk's own rule that makes it formally UNKNOWN rather than low, and it has stayed UNKNOWN through the entire day it needed to be known. ✅ One alarm was retired honestly this morning: the insurance bounce that ran red for two days had drafted from the business account and cleared. 🎯 Reading both transaction lists yourself remains the single highest-value five minutes on this board — no routine can see inside those accounts.

isa.decayPolicy: 🔍 53 OPEN ROWS IN THE CALL LANE THIS EVENING — down from 59 at midday, and the drop is yours: you closed cards by hand between 1:34 and 4:16 this afternoon, including the day's One Thing. ⭐ THE PILE IS STILL PEOPLE, NOT NOISE — seventeen at p1, most of them named human beings with phone numbers who raised a hand about one of YOUR listings and have never been called. 🔴 FOUR NEW p1 ROWS LANDED AT 4:19 AND 4:37 and every one of them is old work surfaced late: a lead your CRM itself flags HOT with a review call overdue since MARCH, three stacked call attempts from July that never connected, and a past client asking for a valuation on her own house since 8/14. 🎯 A ONE-WORD RULING IS STILL WAITING ON YOU about whether this board should auto-expire at all — asked 8/16, and the pile has roughly tripled since.
isa.sweepCadence: every 20 to 30 minutes while the fleet is up — twenty-two sweeps logged since 6:25 this morning, the fullest working day this lane has ever run. 📤 THE WINDOW OPENED ON THE DOT AND DID THE DAY'S BEST WORK IN ITS FIRST SIX MINUTES: three seller first-touches held all through Sunday went out at 7:12, each screened against the stop-request and reply-handoff registers first. Nothing was emailed on a Sunday and nothing was lost by waiting. ✅ SINCE THEN: twenty-one more sends across the follow-up arcs, three texts finally shipped after the compose box was solved with a direct click, one net-new lead caught and answered inside the hour, and six call weaves shipped that a mis-scoped gate had been wrongly hiding. 🔧 THE BUILD YOU APPROVED AT 4:16 IS ALREADY IN FORCE: every call task this lane creates now ships with a tap-to-call link, a pre-written opening text in your voice, and a staged draft where an email exists — a call task with none of the three may no longer be created. ⚠️ Still open: the seller-import lane is signed out, and the activity-feed and geography passes did no work again today.
